card.who: A casual on the quay: fish boxes, ice, whatever the Widow's foreman calls for that morning. He owes Mickey's book fifteen pounds for fares.
card.speak: Young, wary, short answers. Opens up if you are straight with him.
card.life: His dad was a docker till 1989. He stands at the fish dock at six hoping to be picked.
card.fire: He was sent to shift boxes out of No. 3 next morning. Nobody said why No. 3.
card.rivals: The Widow's foreman picks him or does not. Cammack's lads have offered him easier money.
